note: Accuracy cases for Test data's 'Describe the record you need'. Each case is a tester's description and what the criteria must contain. Expected conditions name fields by attribute number, so DICT synonyms count (MODE and S/ORD# are both <2>). op: '=' or '#' with values, 'filled' (has a value), 'range' (GE/LE/GT/LT), 'any' (constrained somehow). Only status=verified cases count toward the score; a draft becomes verified when an SME confirms `expect` and sets reviewed_by. `keys` lists known-good records the criteria must find (optional). This public copy keeps two illustrative cases.

cases.description: an open transfer that has been shipped
cases.note: MODE <2> = S means shipped and not yet received.
